public_rationale: The video-quality comparison holds: Artificial Analysis ranked Veo 2 above Sora before publication. The traction claim is too sweeping under the ordinary adoption reading: January data placed Sora among the leading AI consumer websites, at number 23. That does not prove lasting success, but it contradicts a claim of no meaningful initial traction.
limitations: Website traffic can reflect curiosity rather than sustained production use.
A reading confined to durable commercial success would remain unresolved.
The usage report was published after the post but measures January, within the target period.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Sora went nowhere and Google's Veo2 is probably better.

statement.excerpt: Sora went nowhere; Google’s Veo2 is probably better.

our_interpretation: Read 'went nowhere' as a failure to achieve meaningful product or user traction, rather than literally having no users.
Read 'probably better' as a qualified comparison of generated-video quality, assessed through contemporaneous human-preference evaluations.
Assess Sora's initial public-release period in December 2024 through publication. Later versions and later commercial outcomes do not settle this observation.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence shows negligible meaningful Sora traction and comparable video-quality evaluations favor Veo 2.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence shows meaningful Sora traction or comparable quality evaluations favor Sora. Opposing findings for the two clauses warrant a mixed outcome.
